E0344

Only one switch-off attribute can be written on a statement.

What

Only one switch-off attribute can be written on a statement.

Why

`#Off` and `#DebugOnly` both control whether the same statement emits code.

Fix

Keep one marker: `#Off <statement>` or `#DebugOnly <statement>`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0344: tests/ui/off_debug_doubled_attr.stderr.

Error [E0344]: only one switch-off attribute can be written on a statement
  --> tests/ui/off_debug_doubled_attr.jet:2:10
    |
  2 |     #Off #DebugOnly print("never")
    |          ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#Off` and `#DebugOnly` both control whether the same statement emits code
 Fix: keep one marker: `#Off <statement>` or `#DebugOnly <statement>`
